empty_ways_finding.reason: New unread-gap signals moved 44 commanders from no-signals into signals-but-no-playstyle (221→177 / 165→209). Total empty ways stayed 386 because those signals (card_draw, mana reading, evasion, …) are not sufficient to name a community playstyle, and requires_any was not widened for generic enters/attacks — that would invent matches and burn precision. Shrink would require sourced new playstyles or genuine composition gates, not a fallback.
